purpose: The canonical section sequence of every non-landing page role Skill 71's image pipeline serves. scripts/stage_executor.py check_section_count reads the page role (request page_role, else the run's page-request.json / intake launch.page_role) and, when the role has an entry here, checks the production request against that entry's sequence instead of references/copy-specs/<copy_version>-v6.json. A role with no entry keeps the landing behaviour. The entry is spec-shaped (sequence, sections[].id/job/limits, cta_map) so scripts/build_production_request.py reuses its landing code paths unchanged. Structure only: every wireframe and mockup still takes the client's own brand colors, the Design Board, the design style (A, B, C), the composition library, the hypersaturated grade and the owner's wireframe sheet language (references/wireframe-build-spec.json page_profiles).

downsell_1.label: Downsell

decline.rule: A real outlined secondary button next to every primary button; it never charges.

sections.name: Opening offer
sections.job: make the alternative clear immediately, and state in the first screen that the original order is confirmed and safe
sections.layout: First screen: a thin reassurance band above the headline stating the original order is confirmed, then the offer headline, the body, the money-terms line at body size and the primary button with the outlined decline button beside it. One large image plate on the side.

slots.art_direction: the lighter offer's own imagery, same brand, softer ask

sections.name: First problem
sections.job: a specific pain or objection this alternative answers, distinct from the next two
sections.layout: Text left, image plate right, with icon bullet rows under the body.

slots.art_direction: the person living the first problem, candid, in the brand's own world

sections.name: Second problem
sections.job: a second, different pain or objection
sections.layout: A wide image plate with the centred statement laid over it, then a row of three icon columns under it. Not the geometry of the first problem band.

slots.art_direction: wide scene that shows the second problem, no stock handshake

sections.name: Third problem
sections.job: a third, different pain or objection
sections.layout: A full-width dark band: a large pull statement and the body in one narrow column on a dark card that overlaps the edge of a square image plate on the right. Not the geometry of the first or second problem band.

slots.art_direction: close, emotional portrait for the third problem

sections.name: Why this option
sections.job: the real reason this alternative exists
sections.layout: Image plate on the left, the reason set as a short statement with a supporting paragraph right.

slots.art_direction: the maker of the offer in the work, honest and warm

sections.name: Who it is for
sections.job: who the alternative fits, without shaming anyone who declines
sections.layout: A short list of fit statements on a light ground beside a circular portrait plate; no judgement language.

slots.art_direction: the ideal buyer, confident and at ease

sections.name: Included and not included
sections.job: the exact inclusions and the material limitations, shown with equal honesty
sections.layout: Two equal columns side by side on desktop, INCLUDED and NOT INCLUDED, the same type size and the same row height, then the money-terms line at body size beside the button. Stacked in the same order on mobile.

slots.art_direction: the offer's own deliverables laid out, brand colours

sections.name: When time runs out
sections.job: exactly seven optional benefits the visitor will not receive by declining; never a loss of the original purchase
sections.layout: One numbered list of exactly seven rows on a dark ground, large numerals, each row one benefit; clearly unlike the section 7 columns. Primary button and decline button under the list.

rules: Eight sections, in this order, one request section per page section; never band-compressed.
A purchase button in every section, the one native downsell action, with the decline button beside it.
Section 8 carries exactly seven numbered items under the heading When Time Runs Out.
The three problem sections never share one geometry.
Section 7 and section 8 lists never look alike.
